slides.headline: You Check NEAR Before The Group Leaves
slides.body:
Brickell was “done” 30 seconds ago.
Now you found half the room heading to Wynwood.

photo.prompt: a guy in a black button down checking the NEAR app on his phone while friends hover around him outside a Brickell rooftop elevator, city lights, excited midnight chaos

slides.headline: You Call One More Song At The DJ Booth
slides.body:
The Uber is outside.
Then the DJ drops the song and suddenly nobody has legs.

photo.prompt: a woman in a blue dress pointing toward the DJ booth at a packed South Beach club while her friends turn back from the exit, colorful lasers, crowded dance floor, 1:45am flash photo

slides.headline: You Turn A Wynwood Line Into Plans
slides.body:
Ten people deep at the door.
You already picked the backup bar and the after-after.

photo.prompt: three friends standing in a lively Wynwood bar line under mural-covered walls, one friend confidently showing a map on her phone, string lights, bouncer at the door, late night street scene

slides.headline: You Say South Beach Is Basically Close
slides.body:
From Brickell, this sentence is a lifestyle choice.
Somehow everyone still gets in.

photo.prompt: a group of friends piling into a rideshare outside a Brickell tower, one friend laughing with the South Beach destination open on her phone, palm trees, headlights, 2am Miami street glow

slides.headline: You End The Night With A Beach Plan
slides.body:
It’s 3:26am and you’re assigning sunscreen.
Somehow brunch became sunrise.
